status: Fractional clipped stretch, global mirrors and screen-coordinate HWND bounds verified; overall original Wine acceptance remains incomplete.
changes: Keep fractional source coordinates after destination clipping, derive every piece from the full original mapping, retain global X/Y mirrors and clamp floating roundoff to original source bounds. Keep integer depth path.

Protocol1.9 adds SOURCE_RECT_F32 bit7 without changing80-byte DDBlt layout. Host validates finite positive extents and reads flagged float bits; integer source packets remain compatible, and raw texture copies require integer origins and extents.
Convert HWND client bounds to screen coordinates before clipping. Independent unoccluded HWND native reference confirms the origin.

sourceFreeze.scope: Additional complete source snapshot before first original-suite executable/source.json is emitted; per-run native-source.json retains the previous13 native paths. Protocol header is frozen separately here.

nativeReference.scope: One original system32 DDraw XP boot,116seconds, zero proxy batches/owners. Two software clipped stretches including global X mirror plus a separate HWND clip list/color fill. Final stronger saved-log parser rechecks every result, unique sample and expected color; no second native boot claimed. Global Y mirror is covered by synthetic contract/GPU tests, not by a native Y probe. HWND was unoccluded; no full visible-region/occlusion claim.
